newsitem.title: GERMANY: Boehringer Ingelheim forms deal with Ontogen Corp.
newsitem.headline: Boehringer Ingelheim forms deal with Ontogen Corp.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Boehringer Ingelheim said on Monday it had paid $41.6 million to U.S. group Ontogen Corporation to form a research cooperation designed to speed up drug preparation.

Boehringer and the Carlsbad, California-based group will concentrate on developing automated software and hardware technologies to be used in speeding up the process of preparing chemical substances in the use of drugs production.
The deal is initially scheduled to last four years, and in return for its payment Boehringer will receive the exclusive rights to certain technologies that emerge from the deal.
Boeheringer, which is privately held, added it would make further payments during the life of the deal, dependent on how the cooperation progresses.
Ontogen posted sales of around $22 million last year and employs 38 people.
